claim: Custody of the Tooth Relic functioned as a political-legitimacy asset in the Kandyan sovereignty system and remained politically salient through the 1815 takeover and 1817–18 rebellion.
bounded_by: Political salience is supported; the stronger formula 'whoever holds it rules' is treated as an interpretive compression, not a literal sufficient condition for sovereignty.
notes: Feeds the contemporary sacred-monopoly hypothesis without transporting historical outcomes.
